title: Assembled two-side per-tick fight input log (duel-sim-3)
description: Fight-flow replay-authority log (fight-flow brief Part C sections C0 and C4; DECISIONS #72.18). The client records every input at its fixed 30 Hz tick for BOTH sides (player side from the edge tick queue, CPU side from the seeded in-core brain, recorded for parity only), sends the assembled log at the end, and the host re-runs it through the duel-sim-3 core under the ISSUED rules snapshot (rulesId + rulesHash) and seed, then settles what IT computed; any hash mismatch is rejected. Extends duel-inputs-1 (whose action names it keeps); carries no damage, HP, outcome, reward or client verdict. Each side's stream is a packed byte sequence, one record per tick that changes anything: record = header [dt:ULEB128 if header&7==0] [moveX:int8 moveZ:int8 if bit3] [press:uint8 if bit5 [stepX:int8 stepZ:int8 if press&7==5]] [deploy:uint8 if bit6] [target:uint8 if bit7]; header bits0-2 = dt 1..7 inline (0 = ULEB128 dt follows, only for dt>=8), bit3 move changed, bit4 guard toggled, bit5 press, bit6 deploy pick (own roster index), bit7 target pick (opponent roster index), at least one of bits 3-7; dt = tick - previous record's tick (first previous = -1); press bits0-2 = code (1 light/strike, 2 heavy, 3 special/finisher, 4 feint, 5 step, 6 shove, 7 disengage), bits3-4 = special tier (1 half, 2 full; 0 otherwise), bits5-7 zero; int8 axes are -127..127 (0x80 refused). Levels (move, guard) start at (0,0)/up and persist; a press or pick lasts its tick. Canonical: no empty or redundant records, no padded varints, every tick < tickCount. hashes = concatenated 16-hex prefixes of the core state hash at the end of ticks (k+1)*hashEvery-1, floor(tickCount/hashEvery) of them; finalHash = the full state hash at the end of tick tickCount-1. JSON Schema cannot check the stream grammar, hash count, id uniqueness across sides or roster-index bounds: the runtime decoder (C# FightInputLog.Parse, host mirror) is authoritative.

rulesHash.description: the issued snapshot's canonical hash, echoed; the host refuses a mismatch

stream.description: base64 (standard alphabet, padded) of the side's packed per-tick input records; grammar in the schema description and duel-inputs-2.validation.md
